Name: Time multiplier
Description: Scales the native simulation delta after the timing task. Integer frame waits keep their native behavior. Applies only in stable gameplay; 1 restores normal timing.
RestoreBehavior: Reset to 1 on disable-all or host disconnect; native timing scalar remains untouched.

Evidence.Finding: Task recomputes a fresh delta and its inverse each frame. Trainer scales the fresh delta, caps it at 6 and recomputes the inverse.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Name: Horizontal FOV
Description: Sets and enables the horizontal field of view override in the normal single-camera field renderer.
RestoreBehavior: Released when disabled or when the scene heap, scheduler, full room target, native camera owner or controller mode changes. Re-enable in normal follow-camera gameplay.

Evidence.Finding: Float radians are passed in XMM1, projection pointer in RCX and horizontal selector 0 in R8D before matrix reconstruction.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Evidence.Finding: Only owner 0 and normal controller mode 0 are accepted. Both FOV and held camera bind scheduler, scene heap and the full ten-byte map target. Native ownership changes release the override before render writes.
Evidence.Level: Fresh complete static ASM and independent source review; synthetic renderer-boundary tests; live validation pending

Name: Override field of view

RestoreBehavior: Released when disabled or when the scene heap, scheduler, full room target, native camera owner or controller mode changes. Re-enable in normal follow-camera gameplay.

Evidence.Finding: Only normal single-camera mode and active bank 0 are modified.

Name: Reload current room
Description: Reloads the current room with its current entrance and spawn sets. This does not restore health, inventory or mission progress.
RestoreBehavior: A one-shot scene transition; no automatic undo.

Evidence.Finding: Native wrapper copies a 10-byte target and queues the existing room transition; destination is checked against live area table at [0x2A10558].
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Name: Travel to room
Description: Uses the native developer map jump. Room bounds are checked against loaded data; entrance and spawn availability depend on game content. Spawn set -1 uses saved defaults.
RestoreBehavior: A one-shot scene transition that can affect the next save; no automatic undo.

Evidence.Finding: Native wrapper copies a 10-byte target and queues the existing room transition; destination is checked against live area table at [0x2A10558].
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Name: Disable world and camera effects
Description: Disables trainer timing, field pause, actor/effect freeze and camera overrides and restores owned display flags. One-shot room and party changes remain.
RestoreBehavior: Does not undo progression edits or room transitions.

Evidence.Finding: Restores only owned task callbacks in freshly validated scheduler lists and compare-restores owned flag bits.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Name: Freeze actors and effects
Description: Uses the native actor/effect freeze while rendering continues. Scripts, mission timers, hit processing and some effects can continue. Ends when the scene changes or native code takes control.
RestoreBehavior: Releases the trainer-owned bit in the same scene on disable, menu/transition or disconnect. A pre-existing native freeze is rejected; newer scenes retain their own state.

Evidence.Finding: Actor update skips main behavior, animation and movement while preserving pose/render maintenance. Several effect consumers honor the same bit; it does not stop every subsystem.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Name: Retry native checkpoint
Description: Reloads the game's native checkpoint and rolls inventory, experience, abilities and other saved progress back to that snapshot. The checkpoint may be in an earlier room. This does not capture or rewind an arbitrary combat state.
RestoreBehavior: One-shot native rollback. Disable-all does not undo it. No save file is written; a later normal save can persist the restored state.

Evidence.Finding: Validated native checkpoint buffers and matching saved location feed the existing menu transition. Its restore flag delays SaveData rollback until after scene teardown.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; runtime validation pending

Evidence.Finding: Outer captured-frame drawing survives field module state2. Capture precedes frame finalization. A separate owner bit pauses the native mission clock; a step permits one complete field dispatch and timing update.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; synthetic guards tested; live validation pending

Name: Pause field simulation
Description: Pauses the complete field scheduler and mission clock while showing a captured game image. Audio, play-time counters and outer UI continue. Free camera cannot move within the frozen image. Pause takes effect after the next complete update.
RestoreBehavior: Releases the trainer's field/capture state and timer owner bit on disable, disconnect or transition. Native menu/event takeover is preserved.

Evidence.Finding: Outer captured-frame drawing survives field module state2. Capture precedes frame finalization. A separate owner bit pauses the native mission clock; a step permits one complete field dispatch and timing update.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA verified; synthetic guards tested; live validation pending

Name: Advance one field update
Description: While trainer field pause is active, runs one complete field update and its native timing update, captures the new image, then pauses again. Uses the current native delta; this is not a promise of one fixed real-time frame.
RestoreBehavior: Automatically returns to trainer pause. A scene transition or native menu/event takes control instead.
